lastCompletedStory.title: Wire occupancy backstop into the recycle watcher tick (arm marker when over ceiling)

nextStoryContext: US-003 wired the context-backstop into the recycle watcher (src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts). Four new injectable seams were added to OrchRecycleWatchOptions: readOccupancyFn (reads orchestratorTranscriptPath + parseContextOccupancy; null when transcript absent), armMarkerFn (writes empty ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER file), contextWindow (prod: orchestratorContextWindow()), backstopFraction (prod: ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION = 0.8). The tick sequence is: checkBackstop first (if occupancy > window * fraction -> armMarkerFn), then handleOneTick (sees armed marker -> SIGTERM via existing consume-once path). Unit tests live in test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (4 tests: high-occupancy, low-occupancy, null-occupancy, ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER constant). The integration test (test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts) was not modified and still passes. PRD now has US-001, US-002, and US-003 all with passes=true.
